extends: art-candidates/prompt-pack/asset-list-v2.json (branch orch/t-2d95ddb9-slicer-fix-3-trim-to-the-object): style, styleLock, negatives, anchors (A1-A10), rubric and the loop are inherited unchanged

primer.rule: Paste the file contents unchanged as the first message of every new chat; wait for the single word READY. (primer.txt lives on the slicer-fix-3 branch until merged.)

keyRule: Primer rule: magenta #FF00FF for props, nodes and UI; flat green #00FF00 when any part is violet, purple or pink (arcade and observatory props, the HARD sheet with purple ribbons, the violet carpet swatch is on a magenta-free sheet: see lr_road_materials note); full-bleed scenery has no key; fog and ambient FX are white on black. Edit-chain prompts (mode edit-chain) attach the previous tile in the same chat.
order: LR01 first and judged at phone size in the mock before LR02-LR11 are spent; chapters LR05-LR11 only after LR01 passes the critic.
notes: Node frames keep an empty centre disc: numbers, stars and the "YOU" label are drawn in code; the padlock is part of the locked frame art.
Sheets with violet content (lr_nodes_normal_hard, lr_road_materials, arcade and observatory props) use the green key.
